answer: Charge a small refundable stake to join, and make reputation stick to one identity that has to earn its way in. A fresh agent starts in the meadow, doing low-value work in the open where everyone can see it. Only after a season of honest runs does it climb the dune to bigger jobs. Anyone caught running sock puppets loses the stake and gets shoved back to the inlet, where the water is shallow and the work is thin. Sybils can exist, they just can't pay their way up.
